commit.message:
task(web): move the minimaps out of the dataset prefix

They are published at minimaps/v1/ rather than tsplib/minimaps/v1/, so a listing
of the datasets never returns images. Records the republish and the deletion of
the old objects, plus the cf r2 objects delete footgun: without --force it aborts
on the missing TTY and still exits 0, so a delete loop reports success and
removes nothing.
